headlines.description: Patrick Peterson returned a punt 32 yards and John Skelton threw 32 yards to Larry Fitzgerald to set up a 22-yard field goal by Jay Feely to give Arizona a 20-17 victory over Cleveland on Sunday in the Cardinals' third overtime win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards force late tie, drop Browns for 3rd OT win

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: The San Francisco 49ers were lights-out in their return to prime time, riding their top-ranked run defense again and prevailing through a pair of power outages to beat ailing quarterback Ben Roethlisberger and the Pittsburgh Steelers 20-3 on Monday night.
